# أُسْتَأَمَّ (ʔustaʔamma) /ʔus.ta.ʔam.ma/: first-person singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
# أُسْتَأَمِّ (ʔustaʔammi) /ʔus.ta.ʔam.mi/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
